movesToBottomOfDeck: {player} moves {card} to the bottom of their deck
villagersPlaced: A villager is placed on {target} | {count} villagers are placed on {target}
timeCountersPlaced: A time counter is placed on {target} | {count} time counters are placed on {target}
timeCountersRemoved: A time counter is removed from {target} | {count} time counters are removed from {target}
shuffledIntoQuestDeck: {card} is shuffled into the quest deck
removedFromQuestDeck: {card} is removed from the quest deck
putOnBottomOfQuestDeck: {card} goes to the bottom of the quest deck
shuffledIntoOwnersDeck: {target} is shuffled into its owner's deck
putOnBottomOfOwnersDeck: {target} goes to the bottom of its owner's deck
shuffledIntoEncounterDeck: {target} is shuffled into the encounter deck
returnedToTopOfEncounterDeck: {target} goes back on top of the encounter deck
returnedToBottomOfEncounterDeck: {target} goes to the bottom of the encounter deck
resolvedWhenRevealed: Resolved the When Revealed effect of {card}
addedToStaging: {card} is added to the staging area
placedInStaging: {card} is placed in the staging area
reanimates: One of {player}'s cards rises as a Reanimated Dead
looksAtFacedownSide: {player} looks at the facedown side of {location}
shuffledIntoUnchartedDeck: {location} is shuffled back into the Uncharted deck
unchartedShuffled: The Uncharted locations in the staging area are shuffled
cardsUnderneath: A facedown card underneath | {count} facedown cards underneath
archery: Archery: {count} damage is dealt among the characters
questFails: The quest fails: threat rises by {count}
questTied: The quest is held: no progress, no threat
lostEffects: Lost: every Lost effect in play triggers
discardsAtRandom: {player} discards a card at random | {player} discards {count} cards at random
shufflesDiscardIntoDeck: {player} shuffles their discard pile into their deck
shufflesTopOfDiscardIntoDeck: {player} shuffles the top {count} cards of their discard pile into their deck
undoConfirm: Undo the game back to just before "{entry}"?
eliminationLevelLowered: Each player's threat elimination level drops by {count}
placedUnderneath: A card is placed facedown underneath {target} | {count} cards are placed facedown underneath {target}
separated: The players are separated, each with a staging area of their own
setAsideOutOfPlay: {target} is set aside, out of play
capturedRescued: A captured card is rescued from underneath {card} | {count} captured cards are rescued from underneath {card}
capturedUnderneath: A captured card underneath | {count} captured cards underneath
sailingTest: The first player makes a Sailing test
sailingTestNoCommits: No character commits to the Sailing test
sailingTestResult: The Sailing test looks at {cards}: a sailing success icon | The Sailing test looks at {cards}: {count} sailing success icons
stormcallerProgress: The Stormcaller places {count} progress on its quest stage
stormcallerCaughtUp: The players are at the Stormcaller's stage: the cards in its area are in the staging area
